name: Drawer
summary: A side panel that slides in for a longer edit or detail view — rendered through the shared Drawer.
lead: Drawer carries a mask, focus-trapping, scroll-locking and a slide-in from an edge — too much to rebuild as a web component — so it stays on real Ant: antd v6 (React) and ant-design-vue v4 (Vue), both themed once by the shared drawerTheme, keeping antd's built-in motion. Two implementations, one DS V3 look. This is the composite half of the hybrid.

spec.label: Panel
spec.value: white surface, slides from the right (or any edge)

whenToUse.when: a longer edit form or detail panel where keeping page context matters
a short, blocking decision the user must complete first
the task is large enough to deserve its own route

opinion.note: Give it a clear title and keep the primary action pinned in a footer. Right placement for settings/edit; bottom for mobile-style sheets.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: Composite has no framework-free element, so its paste-and-run form is a CDN-React page — React + antd load from a CDN and mount on open, consuming the same shared drawerTheme. No build step.

codeNote: React and Vue are two real vendor libraries at two Ant generations — they can't share a primitive. They converge via the same drawerTheme; residual drift is caught by visual regression.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Composite shown as a CDN-React page; the drawer is rendered inline (getContainer={false}, open) so the measure reads the real antd v6 drawer content bound to drawerTheme.
